question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Antique
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1, "**Ancient**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Antique**: (प्राचीन) - Belonging to an earlier period, style, or fashion; old and often valuable.

 
 
• **Example**: They furnished their living room with antique furniture from the 18th century.
 
 
 
• **Ancient**: (अति प्राचीन) - Belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence (for civilizations, cities, etc.
 
 
• **Example**: The museum houses ancient artifacts from the Bronze Age.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Ancient"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **New**: (नया) - Not existing before; made, introduced, or discovered recently or now for the first time.
 
• **Gothic**: (गॉथिक) - Relating to the Goths or their extinct East Germanic language, which provides the name for a style of architecture, art, and literature.
 
• **Modern**: (आधुनिक) - Relating to the present or recent times as opposed to the remote past.
